stats.text:
Primal forces now help fuel you on your journeys, granting you the following benefits.

***Temporary Hit Points.*** As a {ref:glossary/magic} action, you can give yourself a number of {ref:glossary/temporary-hit-points} equal to 1d8 plus your Wisdom modifier (minimum of 1). You can use this action a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {ref:glossary/long-rest}.

***Decrease Exhaustion.*** Whenever you finish a {ref:glossary/short-rest}, your {ref:condition/exhaustion} level, if any, decreases by 1.
